profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | React, Next.js, TypeScript | Real-Time Applications & Geospatial Visualization
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software engineer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and real-time web applications. I own features from technical design through production, including complex frontend interfaces and the backend functionality supporting them.

At Aerodome, I designed and delivered Aerovision, combining live WebRTC drone video, Mapbox overlays, and telemetry at 30 updates per second to give operators real-time geographic context. After Aerodome’s acquisition by Flock Safety, I further optimized the system to reduce latency and improve responsiveness, and implemented features across the frontend and GraphQL backend using REST APIs, WebSockets, and Redis-backed fan-out.

My work also includes real-time incident mapping, pilot-location workflows, and automated flight reporting that replaces much of the handwritten reporting and manual report assembly. Earlier in my career, I built drone operations SaaS products and enterprise geospatial applications at AgEagle, Colliers, and CBRE.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Joined Flock Safety through its acquisition of Aerodome, continuing development of the real-time drone operations platform.
• Implemented real-time features across the React/TypeScript frontend and Node.js GraphQL backend for frontend (BFF), integrating REST APIs, WebSockets, and Redis-backed fan-out to deliver telemetry and operational data to browser clients.
• Optimized Aerovision by filtering map layers and data and improving browser and BFF processing to reduce latency and improve responsiveness during live drone operations.
• Reduced unnecessary React re-renders by moving high-frequency telemetry calculations into middleware and using refs and requestAnimationFrame to manage rendering.
• Built Flock911 map interfaces displaying real-time 911 events and incident locations, enabling operators to direct drones to those locations.
• Implemented Remote ID workflows to record pilot locations and transmit them to the drone and dispatch system.
• Designed and delivered automated flight reporting that compiles flight data in real time and generates shareable PDF reports with maps, imagery, and flight details, replacing much of the handwritten reporting and manual assembly.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · Node.js · JavaScript · React.js · Redux.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Mapbox GL · deck.gl · GraphQL · WebSocket · TypeScript · Redis · Webrtc · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hired directly by Aerodome after supporting the company through a RIIS contract assignment. Continued with the team following its acquisition by Flock Safety.
• Owned technical design, implementation, and delivery of Aerovision using React, TypeScript, Mapbox GL, and live WebRTC video, processing drone telemetry at 30 updates per second to provide real-time geographic context.
• Built overlays showing street labels, points of interest, and police dispatch events directly on live drone video for remote operators.
